MISSION THE LAST DETERRENT
SITUATION OPAREA: Sea of Okhotsk bastion. Delta III K-433 is inside a layered Victor, Alfa, and surface screen.
MISSION Destroy K-433 and withdraw from the bastion.
EXECUTION Locate and destroy K-433, then break through the layered screen and exit the bastion.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Weapons release is authorized against K-433 and immediate screen elements. Preserve an escape route.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum and USS San Francisco are assigned; their losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
